Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Optional capture runs with Rotation Solver Reborn's Beastmaster rotation.
- Capture all available overworld beasts at your level, with automatic retries.
- Go to next target and Capture all controls on the Bestiary toolbar.
- Search the spawn area on foot when no eligible beast is nearby.
- Continue toward the destination after teleporting to another zone.
- Wait 3 seconds for capture results before trying another beast.
- Retry after target loss; recognize respawns and preserve cancellation reasons.

Full details on GitHub repo:
